messages:
michaela: FYI -- CI logs for the onboarding run leaked customer internal_id and email for a failed background job. Repro on sample-app background worker with RW_LOG_LEVEL=debug.

tony: can you paste the offending line (redact locally if needed)?

michaela: heres what I captured from the runner: [ERROR] job:process id=job_812 user_email=cust.bot@example.com internal_id=acct-9901 err=AuthRetry

frank: thats a new vector: our redaction currently targets HTTP request/response logging but not background job logs or CI artifacts. the logger adapter isn't applied in the worker process.

michaela: also noticed OpenTelemetry spans for asynchronous jobs don't get the `rw.request_id` attribute so trace/log correlation is missing for job retries. spans are created, but attribute set only in express middleware.

tony: fix plan: (1) move redaction to the core logging adapter so both server and worker processes pass messages through sanitizer, (2) add an "error scrubber" that searches message strings and error objects for email/jwt/account ids and masks them before writing, (3) ensure our job runner generates/propagates request id header (x-rw-request-id) and sets otel attr `rw.request_id` on job spans.

frank: small sample config for sample app README: 
```json
{
  "telemetry.redact": true,
  "telemetry.redact_patterns": ["email","jwt","account_id"],
  "telemetry.request_id_header": "x-rw-request-id",
  "telemetry.default_log_level": "info",
  "telemetry.debug_env_var": "RW_DEBUG"
}
```

michaela: suggest default: INFO for CI/demo to avoid accidental PII capture. DEBUG only when RW_DEBUG=true and with a note in onboarding checklist.

tony: tests to add: unit sanitizer for nested Error objects and strings, integration that runs a background job, captures worker logs at INFO, and asserts no email/account-id patterns are present. also add an otel smoke that asserts job span contains `rw.request_id`.

frank: implementation notes: for Node worker use the same logger factory as main process; for Go background worker wrap zerolog hook. for CI artifacts we should redact before uploading logs to GCS/CI UI. add a small post-processor step in the CI pipeline to scrub artifacts as a last line of defense.

security: flagged RW-PII-803: "worker logs leaking PII + missing request_id on job spans" assigned to tony/frank, label=PII, priority=high.

michaela: thanks. tony can you open PR and CI patch? aim to hotfix before next onboarding demo.

tony: will do. target patch in 48h. need one quick reviewer. ping @frank after code is up.

ops-bot: created ticket #4983: "telemetry: redact worker logs + attach rw.request_id to job spans" assigned to tony/frank

michaela: adding onboarding checklist item: "confirm RW_DEBUG is unset in demo/CI and RW_SAFE_DEMO=true if available".
